headline: Iran: We have reduced the deadline for reopening the Strait of Hormuz from 7 days to two days
summary: Iran's deputy foreign minister said Tehran has reduced the deadline for implementing its plan to open the Strait of Hormuz from seven days to two. The strait is a key route for oil shipments.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints, so changes to its access affect global crude supply expectations.
why_moved: Shorter timelines for reopening a critical oil shipping route can raise expectations of faster changes to tanker traffic and crude supply. Uncertainty over the route tends to lift oil prices.
